1.name: Monsters vs. Detectives
1.overview: The monsters are in a meeting, talking amongst themselves about the detectives and discussing what to do with them. The leader of the monsters says he's tired of the detectives and tells them to make up their minds soon. Then the plague monsters agree and say that the leader of the monsters is right, the Destruction monster says that he has an idea to finish them off, the leader of the monsters asks what the idea is and the monster The Destruction tells them to have a power contest: detectives versus monsters. The Monster Leader agrees, and the fight begins with Detective Holmes vs. Lava Monster. They start the fight with...Powers pitted against each other.

overview: The monsters are tired of detectives, and in their minds, detectives are causing disasters in the universe, on Earth, and in the monster world. Detectives are everywhere in the universe solving these problems. The monsters can't stand them anymore and want to get rid of them. But instead of just getting rid of them, the monsters decide to engage in a power struggle against them. Now, who will win? Monsters or Detectives? Monsters from mythology or elemental beings versus historical or fictional detectives.
title: MONSTERS VS DETECTIVES
